title: Obdavčimo najbogatejše: koliko prihodkov bi lahko prinesla obdavčitev bogatašev?
summary: Four scenarios for a tax on wealth above $100 million in Europe; for Slovenia a progressive wealth tax is estimated at over EUR 0.5 billion a year.

title: Stališča ZSSS na Predlog izhodišč za obdavčitev premoženja
summary: Union reply to the Finance Ministry consultation asking for a tax on the whole wealth of individuals, financial assets included, not only real estate.
